title: BetterSpears
description: Upgrade your combat with BetterSpears. Adding a new tier of overpowered spears for the ultimate survival experience.
body:
BetterSpears
Bring a new level of power to your server with BetterSpears. This plugin introduces a tier of weaponry that makes standard swords look like toothpicks. Designed for survival and PvP environments where strength is everything, these spears give players the edge they need to rule the map.

Total Battlefield Control
Traditional Minecraft combat can feel limited. BetterSpears breaks those limits by providing weapons with massive damage outputs and incredible utility. These aren't just decorative items; they are high-performance tools of destruction. Whether you are running a faction or a hardcore survival server, these spears provide the "OP" experience your players crave.

Plugin Highlights
Maximum Damage: These weapons are tuned for high-impact combat to ensure every strike counts.

Server Friendly: Works right out of the box with no client-side mods required for your players.

Superior Lightning: Strike your enemies with alot of lightning!

Enhanced Combat Flow: Give your community a fresh way to fight that rewards aggressive and powerful playstyles.

Why Choose BetterSpears?
Most weapon plugins try to play it safe with balance. BetterSpears is for the server owners who want their players to feel like gods. If you want gear that truly stands out and offers a significant power creep over vanilla items, this is the plugin for you
